title: Dr / Paediatrician
specialties: Paediatric gender-affirming care, puberty suppression, gender-affirming hormones (oestrogen, testosterone)
name: Dr Cate Rayner
description: Paediatrician; Director, Department of Adolescent Medicine and Director of the RCH Gender Service (joined 2021). The RCH Gender Service (Victorian statewide public service) provides assessment, education and prescribing of gender-affirming medicines (pubertal suppression, oestrogen, testosterone) for trans and gender diverse children and adolescents, prescribed by its paediatricians/paediatric endocrinologists. New referrals accepted up to the 16th birthday; referral from a GP or paediatrician required (fax form to 03 9345 5034). Long waitlist.
